shortlist.name: C12-200 (hepatocyte)
shortlist.source: Love et al. PNAS 2010 / numerous reviews
shortlist.notes: Strong hepatocyte uptake; widely used for hepatic gene editing.

shortlist.name: SM-102 (Moderna)
shortlist.source: Hou et al. 2021 / Spikevax FDA label
shortlist.notes: Clinical benchmark for mRNA vaccines; hepatic + splenic delivery.

shortlist.name: ALC-0315 (Pfizer/BioNTech)
shortlist.source: Hou et al. 2021 / Comirnaty EMA EPAR
shortlist.notes: Clinical benchmark; broader tropism than SM-102 in some tissues.

notes: Liver is the natural sink for systemically administered LNPs.
Cas9 mRNA + sgRNA co-delivery: C12-200 or similar hepatotropic LNPs.
Gene editing needs high transfection + minimal double-stranded RNA contaminants.
